name: Tanjiro Kamado
biography: Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps after a demon attacks his family and turns his sister Nezuko into one. He is determined to find a way to help her, and his kindness stays with him even when a fight gets difficult. Along the way, he learns Water Breathing and the Sun Breathing style known as Hinokami Kagura.

traits.abilities: Sun Breathing, Water Breathing, Keen Sense of Smell, Demon Slayer Mark
traits.quote: No matter how many people you may lose, you have no choice but to go on living.

name: Levi Ackerman
biography: Levi is the captain of the Survey Corps' Special Operations Squad and one of its most capable soldiers. He can seem distant, but he cares deeply about the people under his command. His skill with the blades makes him a formidable opponent for the Titans.

traits.role: Captain of the Special Operations Squad
traits.abilities: Ackerman Awakening, God-tier Maneuver Gear Mastery, Tactical Genius
traits.quote: The only thing we're allowed to do is believe that we won't regret the choice we made.

name: Satoru Gojo
biography: Gojo is a teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High and one of the strongest sorcerers around. His Six Eyes and Limitless technique make him a difficult opponent, but he is just as focused on preparing his students to build a better future for the jujutsu world.

traits.abilities: Limitless, Infinity, Cursed Technique Reversal: Red, Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue, Hollow Purple, Domain: Unlimited Void
traits.quote: Don't worry, I'm the strongest.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
biography: Luffy sets out to find the One Piece and become King of the Pirates, bringing the Straw Hat crew along for the ride. He is cheerful, stubborn, and fiercely loyal to his friends. His Devil Fruit powers have grown in surprising ways, including the form known as Gear 5.

traits.role: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates / Emperor
traits.abilities: Gear 5 (Sun God Nika), Advanced Conqueror's Haki, Rubber Physiology
traits.quote: If you don't take risks, you can't create a future!

name: Frieren
biography: Frieren is an elf who helped the Hero Party defeat the Demon King. Because she lives far longer than humans, she did not realize how much her short journey with Himmel meant to her until it was over. Her later travels give her a chance to understand those memories and the people she meets along the way.

traits.abilities: Zoltraak offensive magic, Mana suppression camouflage, Ancient spell analysis
traits.quote: It was only ten years. But it was that tenth of a percent of my life that changed me forever.

name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
biography: Malenia is an Empyrean demigod who has lived with the Scarlet Rot since birth. She is a skilled swordswoman, and her battle at the Haligtree is one of the toughest challenges in Elden Ring. Her loyalty to her twin brother Miquella is central to her story.

traits.abilities: Waterfowl Dance, Scarlet Aeonia bloom, Life-steal on strike, Prosthetic katana mastery
traits.quote: I am Malenia, Blade of Miquella. And I have never known defeat.

name: Geralt of Rivia
biography: Geralt is a Witcher: a monster hunter trained to survive dangerous work. He tries to follow his own code in a world where the right choice is rarely obvious. In The Witcher 3, he searches for Ciri while dealing with monsters, politics, and old friends along the way.

traits.abilities: Witcher Signs (Igni, Quen, Aard, Axii, Yrden), Alchemical concoctions, Enhanced senses
traits.quote: Evil is evil. Lesser, greater, middling, it's all the same. If I have to choose, I'd rather not choose at all.

name: Johnny Silverhand
biography: Johnny Silverhand was the frontman of Samurai and a loud critic of corporations like Arasaka. Long after his death, a digital copy of him ends up in V's head through the Relic. Johnny is not exactly an easy roommate, and the two are forced to figure out what to do next together.

traits.abilities: Malorian Arms 3516 marksmanship, Cybernetic silver arm, Cyberpunk charisma
traits.quote: Wake the f*** up, Samurai. We have a city to burn.

name: Link
series: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
biography: Link is Hyrule's quiet hero, known for taking on impossible odds rather than backing away from them. In Tears of the Kingdom, he explores the skies and depths of Hyrule with new abilities granted through his arm, all while trying to find Zelda and protect the kingdom.

traits.role: Champion of Hyrule / Hero of the Wild
traits.abilities: Ultrahand, Fuse, Ascend, Recall, Master Sword swordsmanship
traits.quote: ...HYAAAH!

name: Cloud Strife
biography: Cloud starts out as a mercenary in Midgar, carrying the enormous Buster Sword and keeping most people at a distance. His work with Avalanche pulls him into a much bigger conflict with Sephiroth and the fate of the planet. As the journey goes on, Cloud also has to sort through his own memories and identity.

traits.abilities: Buster Sword, Omnislash Limit Break, Mako Infusion, Materia Magic
traits.quote: Not interested. But I won't let Sephiroth destroy this world.

name: Tony Stark (Iron Man)
biography: Tony Stark begins as a brilliant inventor who thinks he can solve everything on his own. Building the Iron Man armor changes how he sees his work and the people affected by it. Over the years, he becomes one of the Avengers' most important members and makes the ultimate sacrifice to stop Thanos.

traits.abilities: Nanotech Mark 85 Armor, Genius-level Intellect, Repulsor Beams, Friday AI
traits.quote: And I... am... Iron Man.

name: Miles Morales (Spider-Man)
biography: Miles is a Brooklyn teenager trying to balance family, school, and being Spider-Man. In Across the Spider-Verse, he is pulled into the Spider-Society and clashes with its rules about how his story is supposed to go. Miles wants to protect the people he loves and make his own choices.

traits.abilities: Bio-electric Venom Strike, Camouflage Invisibility, Spider-Sense, Wall-crawling
traits.quote: Everyone keeps telling me how my story is supposed to go. Nah. Imma do my own thing.

name: Paul Atreides (Muad'Dib)
biography: Paul is the heir to House Atreides, whose move to Arrakis changes his life completely. He learns from the Fremen and begins to understand the future he may be heading toward. His choices carry enormous consequences for the people of Arrakis and beyond.

traits.abilities: Prescience / Future Sight, The Voice (Bene Gesserit), Prana-bindu conditioning, Crysknife combat
traits.quote: May thy knife chip and shatter.

name: Bruce Wayne (Batman)
biography: Bruce Wayne uses his resources, detective skills, and years of training to protect Gotham as Batman. He has no superpowers, so he relies on preparation and persistence. His work often puts him up against criminals who know exactly how to exploit the city's weaknesses.

traits.abilities: Master Tactician, Peak Human Conditioning, Batmobile / Tumbler, Batarangs & Grapple
traits.quote: It's not who I am underneath, but what I do that defines me.

name: Darth Vader (Anakin Skywalker)
biography: Anakin Skywalker was once a Jedi with a promising future, but fear and the influence of Palpatine led him to the dark side. As Darth Vader, he serves the Empire in life-support armor. His past as Anakin never fully disappears, even after everything he has done.

traits.role: Sith Lord / Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet
traits.abilities: Dark Side Force Choke & Telekinesis, Form V Lightsaber Mastery, Unmatched Pilot
traits.quote: I find your lack of faith disturbing.

name: Eleven (Jane Hopper)
biography: Eleven escapes from Hawkins Lab with powers she is still learning to understand. Mike, Dustin, Lucas, and Hopper become her friends and family, helping her build a life beyond the lab. Her connection to the Upside Down keeps drawing her into danger, and she often has to use her abilities to protect the people she loves.

traits.abilities: Telekinesis, Remote Viewing, Astral Projection, Inter-dimensional gate control
traits.quote: Friends don't lie.

name: Jinx (Powder)
biography: Jinx is a brilliant inventor from Zaun whose relationship with her sister Vi was changed by a painful childhood tragedy. She builds weapons like Fishbones and Pow-Pow, and her actions often push the conflict between Zaun and Piltover further out of control. Underneath the chaos, she is still trying to make sense of who she is to the people she loves.

traits.abilities: Superhuman Speed & Reflexes (Shimmer infusion), Demolitions Mastery, Fishbones Rocket Launcher
traits.quote: I thought maybe you could love me like you used to. Even though I'm different.

name: Joel Miller
biography: Joel has spent years surviving in a world devastated by the Cordyceps outbreak. He is asked to escort Ellie across the country, and their uneasy partnership slowly becomes something much closer. His past loss shapes the way he protects her, sometimes with consequences neither of them can escape.

traits.abilities: Guerilla Tactics, Improvised Crafting, Stealth Combat, Marksmanship
traits.quote: You have no idea what loss is. But you keep going for family.

name: Daemon Targaryen
biography: Daemon is the younger brother of King Viserys and a dragonrider bonded with Caraxes. Brave, volatile, and ambitious, he rarely follows the path expected of him. His choices make him a powerful ally to Rhaenyra and a dangerous opponent to anyone who stands in his way.

traits.abilities: Dark Sister Valyrian Sword combat, Dragonriding (Caraxes), Battle Strategy
traits.quote: Dreams didn't make us kings. Dragons did.

name: Walter White (Heisenberg)
biography: Walter White is a chemistry teacher whose cancer diagnosis leads him into the drug trade. He says he is doing it for his family, but pride and the power he gains start to shape his choices. His transformation into Heisenberg is at the heart of Breaking Bad.

traits.abilities: Chemical Engineering Prowess, Psychological Manipulation, Tactical Forethought
traits.quote: I am the one who knocks!

name: RM (Kim Namjoon)
biography: RM is the leader of BTS and is known for his thoughtful lyrics and work as a rapper and producer. He has also released music as a solo artist and spoken publicly about identity and self-expression. His curiosity and love of language often show up in his work.

traits.abilities: Flow Versatility, Songwriting & Production, Philosophical Storytelling, Global Diplomacy
traits.quote: No matter who you are, where you're from, your skin colour, gender identity: speak yourself.

name: Jennie Kim
biography: Jennie is a rapper and vocalist in BLACKPINK, as well as a solo artist. She is known for her confident stage presence and a style that moves easily between music and fashion. Her solo songs, including 'SOLO', have given fans another side of her work to follow.

traits.role: BLACKPINK Main Rapper / Vocalist / Fashion Icon
traits.abilities: Rapid Rap Cadence, Stage Presence, Global Fashion Trendsetter, Vocal Versatility
traits.quote: Bitch, I'm a shining solo.

name: Bang Chan
biography: Bang Chan is the leader of Stray Kids and part of the producing unit 3RACHA. He works across songwriting, production, vocals, and performance, helping shape the group's sound. Fans also know him for the close connection he keeps with the group's audience.

traits.abilities: Music Production (DAW Mastery), Intense Choreography, Multilingual Communication
traits.quote: Stray Kids everywhere all around the world. You make Stray Kids stay.

name: Hanni Pham
biography: Hanni is a Vietnamese-Australian singer in NewJeans. Her warm vocals and relaxed performance style stand out in songs such as 'Hype Boy' and 'OMG'. She has also taken part in songwriting and brings an easy, playful energy to the group.

traits.abilities: Honey Vocals, Y2K Nostalgic Groove, Ukulele & Acoustic Guitar, Lyric Writing
traits.quote: Cause I know what you like boy, you're my chemical hype boy.

name: Karina (Yoo Ji-min)
biography: Karina is the leader of aespa and is known for her dance, stage presence, and sharp performance style. The group's sci-fi concept runs through songs like 'Next Level' and 'Supernova', with Karina often at the centre of its story and visuals.

traits.abilities: High-speed Precision Choreography, Kwangya Metaverse Sync, Vocal Belting
traits.quote: I'm the drama. It all begins with me.

name: Peter Parker (The Amazing Spider-Man)
biography: Peter Parker gets his spider-like powers as a teenager and learns from Uncle Ben that having power means taking responsibility for how he uses it. Since then, he has tried to balance everyday problems with protecting New York as Spider-Man. That mix of ordinary life and superhero trouble is a big part of his appeal.

traits.abilities: Spider-Sense precognition, Web-shooter invention, Wall-crawling, 10-ton proportional strength
traits.voiceActor: Created by Stan Lee & Steve Ditko
traits.quote: With great power comes great responsibility.

name: Clark Kent (Superman)
biography: Kal-El was sent from Krypton as a baby and raised by Jonathan and Martha Kent in Smallville. On Earth, he became Superman, using his powers to protect people while holding on to the values his parents taught him. Clark's life as a reporter helps keep him connected to the people he serves.

traits.role: Man of Steel / Justice League Leader
traits.abilities: Superhuman strength & speed, Heat vision, Freeze breath, Invulnerability, Flight
traits.voiceActor: Created by Jerry Siegel & Joe Shuster
traits.quote: There is a right and a wrong in the universe, and that distinction is not hard to make.

name: Wolverine (Logan)
biography: Logan is a mutant with a powerful healing factor, heightened senses, and a long, complicated past. The Weapon X program bonded adamantium to his skeleton and turned him into a formidable fighter. He can be rough around the edges, but his loyalty to the people he cares about runs deep.

traits.abilities: Adamantium Claws & Skeleton, Rapid Cellular Regeneration, Berserker Rage
traits.voiceActor: Created by Roy Thomas, Len Wein & John Romita Sr.
traits.quote: I'm the best there is at what I do. But what I do best isn't very nice.

name: Mark Grayson (Invincible)
biography: Mark is a high school student whose Viltrumite powers appear just as he starts learning what his father has been hiding. Becoming Invincible means facing threats he is not always ready for and deciding what kind of hero he wants to be. His family history makes that choice much harder.

traits.role: Viltrumite Defender / Guardian of the Globe
traits.abilities: Viltrumite physiology, Atmospheric flight, Extreme durability, Accelerated healing
traits.voiceActor: Created by Robert Kirkman & Cory Walker
traits.quote: I'll still have you, Dad.

name: Dream of the Endless (Morpheus)
biography: Morpheus, also known as Dream, rules the Dreaming and is one of the Endless, beings tied to the oldest parts of existence. After decades in captivity, he returns to a realm that has changed without him. Reclaiming his tools is only the beginning; he also has to face the choices he made before his imprisonment.

traits.role: Lord of the Dreaming / One of the Seven Endless
traits.abilities: Dream Reality Manipulation, Immortality, Omnipresence in the Dreaming realm
traits.voiceActor: Created by Neil Gaiman, Sam Kieth & Mike Dringenberg
traits.quote: You say that I have no power here. Perhaps you speak truly... But what power would Hell have if those here imprisoned could not dream of heaven?

name: Guts (The Black Swordsman)
biography: Guts has known hardship from the start and grows up fighting as a mercenary. He later joins the Band of the Falcon, but Griffith's betrayal changes his life and leaves him marked by the Brand of Sacrifice. Carrying the enormous Dragon Slayer, Guts keeps moving forward even when the odds are awful.

traits.role: The Black Swordsman / Brand of Sacrifice Bearer
traits.abilities: Dragon Slayer greatsword mastery, Berserker Armor, Prosthetic Arm Cannon & Repeater Crossbow
traits.quote: He who acts out of love is immortal. Struggle, contend, wriggle! That alone is the sword of one who confronts death!

name: Denji (Chainsaw Man)
biography: Denji grows up struggling with debt and has very simple hopes for a better life. After Pochita saves him, the two become one and Denji gains the power to turn parts of himself into chainsaws. He joins Public Safety as a Devil Hunter and quickly learns that the people around him have their own plans.

traits.role: Chainsaw Devil Hybrid / Public Safety Hunter
traits.abilities: Chainsaw transformation, Blood rejuvenation, Devil erasure physiology
traits.quote: If there's gonna be a hell, I'll turn it into my own damn paradise!

name: Thorfinn Karlsefni
biography: Thorfinn grows up wanting revenge on Askeladd, and that goal shapes much of his early life. After years of war and hardship, he starts to question what all that violence has cost him. His later journey is about trying to live differently and finding a place where people can be free from war.

traits.abilities: Dual Dagger Lightning Reflexes, Close Quarters Krav-Maga Style Disarming, Indomitable Will
traits.quote: I have no enemies. No one in the world is my enemy.

name: Miyamoto Musashi (Shinmen Takezo)
biography: Musashi begins as a fierce young swordsman determined to become unbeatable. His travels through Japan bring him into duels and encounters that challenge what strength means to him. Over time, the story follows him from raw ambition toward a quieter understanding of skill and life.

traits.abilities: Niten Ichi-ryu (Two-Heaven style), Zen sword mindfulness, Preternatural reaction time
traits.quote: Preoccupied with a single leaf... you won't see the tree. Preoccupied with a single tree... you'll miss the entire forest.

name: Sung Jin-woo (Shadow Monarch)
biography: Jin-woo starts out as one of the weakest hunters, taking dangerous jobs because his family needs the money. After surviving the Double Dungeon, he gains access to a System that lets him grow stronger. His rise changes his life, but it also draws him into a conflict far bigger than he expected.

traits.abilities: Shadow Extraction (Arise), Ruler's Authority, Monarch's Domain, Infinite Stat Scaling
traits.quote: Arise.
